Bus Bound is set to arrive on PlayStation 5 April 30, 2026⏱️🚏

Take the wheel of officially licensed buses and improve the quality of life in an evolving, vibrant city. 🌇⏫ Transform a fictional American city into a public transit paradise one stop at a time.

Pre-order the Standard or Deluxe editions to receive the Horizon Hydrogen 40ft Gen2 bus and a skin pack featuring three modern skins for your buses. 

Deluxe Edition pre-orders will also include the Horizon Speed 40ft bus, a retro-style skin pack, and the Bus Pass, guaranteeing day-one access to the first three content expansions through 2026.
